attribution.legal_posture: Current OFAC exact-ID component-table data confirms the administrative-list entry and adds only the bounded structured context stated here. The record names an OFAC-designated DPRK national; the Federal Register provides durable publication of the same OFAC administrative designation action already represented; the source describes a leader of an IT-worker team in Boten, Laos. The team-lead account is source-bounded; independent corroboration and a new legal event are absent. The administrative notice supplies the list entry and alternate name form, while the separate Boten team-lead narrative remains source-unlinked. Administrative sanctions designation; criminal charge or conviction is outside the designation.

identity_boundary: Yun Song Guk, listed by OFAC as YUN, Song Guk with the alternate romanization YUN, So'ng-kuk, is the DPRK national Treasury reported as leading an IT-worker group in Boten, Laos. Amnokgang Technology Development Company was designated in the same action; the reviewed sources leave Yun's organizational affiliation unresolved, and co-listing supplies separate designation context.
